# IMQRPCRequest.sentAt property

When the client handed the call to the queue, in milliseconds since the epoch by the caller's clock.

**Signature:**

```typescript
sentAt?: number;
```

## Remarks

Set by the client immediately before sending, after `beforeCall` ran. Read back on the client only, so the service's clock never meets it; see [callTiming()](/api/rpc/latest/rpc.calltiming/)<!-- -->.
